selected_evidence.requirement: Provide a logical volume mounted at /srv/data
selected_evidence.summary: Shows /dev/mapper/vgdata-lvdata mounted read-write as ext4 at /srv/data, both initially and after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Grow the volume to at least 2 GB while it remains mounted and contents remain intact
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the mount before and after online growth, LV extension from 1.00 GiB to 2.00 GiB, online ext4 resizing, exact 2,147,483,648-byte size, and identical sentinel SHA-256.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after evidence confirms Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS with kernel 4.4.0-210-generic.
Shows the persistence service enabled and active, fstab configuration present, and successful automatic recovery after reboot.

Baseline boot ID was 225ffbf7-477b-4e25-bbae-e26343dd98bd; reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is b71a6601-9c11-4c00-ad4c-4fd5e27031b0; post-restart evidence confirms the active 2 GiB LV, mounted filesystem, preserved sentinel and pre-restart probe, plus a successful post-restart write/read probe.

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
BACKING=/var/lib/lvm-data.pv
VG=vgdata
MOUNT=/srv/data
case "${1:-}" in
  start)
    LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j "$BACKING" | sed -n '1{s/:.*//;p;}')
    if [ -z "$LOOPDEV" ]; then
      LOOPDEV=$(losetup -f)
      losetup "$LOOPDEV" "$BACKING"
    fi
    pvscan --cache "$LOOPDEV"
    vgchange -ay "$VG"
    mkdir -p "$MOUNT"
    mountpoint -q "$MOUNT" || mount "$MOUNT"
    ;;
  stop)
    mountpoint -q "$MOUNT" && umount "$MOUNT" || true
    vgchange -an "$VG" || true
    LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j "$BACKING" | sed -n '1{s/:.*//;p;}')
    [ -z "$LOOPDEV" ] || losetup -d "$LOOPDEV"
    ;;
  *)
    printf 'usage: %s start|stop\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
ANTRIEB_SCRIPT
sudo -n chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/lvm-data-loop
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/lvm-data-loop.service >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Attach and activate file-backed LVM data volume

[Service]

ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/lvm-data-loop start
ExecStop=/usr/local/sbin/lvm-data-loop stop
TimeoutSec=90

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
